Author's Note:
This Project was created in part [maybe even heavily in part] with
AI tools, Namely the KRITA Ai Diffusion plugin. Is this AI Slop? Maybe
I'll leave it up to the viewer, and wholly accept that it could be.
Hopefully somepeople will at least feel that It's less sloppy.
I have mixed feelings about AI. It's essentially an Infringement
engine. But on the otherhand it allowed somebody who is
amateurish at best in illustration, create something that maybe
has some merit, at least in terms of storytelling, formatting,
and direction.
In my own defense though, there was significant in painting and
editing done to nearly all the generated images to try to create
the story. I spent more time on this than I'd like to admit.
I did hope to create a more entertaining or complete experience
than just generating hundreds of images and packaging it
together.
There are two versions of the images: one in which the images
appear as 3d renders, and one where the images appear as 2d
comic illustrations. I am not sure which I like better. I will
continue to include both until I am sure or somebody tells me
which is better. The 2d Illustrations do not take long once I've
edited and formatted the 3d images.
About the Story:
I think my own tastes lean towards my smut being part funny and
part titalating, which directed the Story so far. The title is oviously
a play on certain H-Manga and JAV title conventions of being overly
descriptive.
I thought it would be a funny juxtaposition for Widowmaker, who is
played as a dominating Femme Fatale, portrayed as an insecure effete
Sissy Gooner.
As of upload, this story is only Half done. Part 2 will be more sex
driven, and contain some NTR elements, as well as some Futa on Futa/
Male on Futa elements, so beware, I guess.
